text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, thank you very mu... huh?\nWhy do 
you two have that sparkly look in your 
eyes...?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm so excited... Scarlet-san, 
with the Super Pretty Princess Plan, let's 
party!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Super Princess...? Um? The princess is 
Kawakami-san, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I meaaan, the star of today is 
Scarlet-chan after aaall♪ Presents, 
presents!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I prepared all sorts of dresses and makeup 
tools to give her the ultimate princess 
experience! It's a plan of pure genius!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! I shall also pass on all 
the princess-like comportment I have 
learned! Please, accept my teachings!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just for me, you went through all that 
trouble? ...I'm so happy. But since we're 
here, why don't all three of us transform 
together?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Because that'll definitely make for the 
most glamorous and amazingly fun birthday 
ever, won't it?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My! In that case, I want to have a dance 
party too! And after that, a 
fiery-spirited brawl to decide the 
ultimate princess—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa☆ Kawakami-senpai's princess vibes are 
seriously intense~! What's the grand 
prize, a tiara? Heheh, I might have to get 
serious♡
